findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): downloadUrl is not browsing history
findings.evidence: AppVersionManager.kt:18,68,75: loadUrl matches the substring of downloadUrl. The value is a fixed example APK URL, not visited websites. triggerAutoUpdate copies sourceDir to a cache APK and invokes the system installer at lines 79-96; it does not load websites or transmit browsing history.
findings.recommendation: No browsing-history declaration follows from this match. Reassess if a real web or update client is added.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): uid matches Guide identifiers, not user accounts
findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt:75,135,416,755-756 references YouTubeAccessibilityGuideDialog/showAccessibilityGuideDialog. YouTubeAccessibilityGuideDialog.kt:34 declares its composable name. The uid pattern matches Guide, with no account ID or account transmission in these paths. Dialog settings intents use the app package, not a person identifier.
findings.recommendation: Exclude these lexical false positives from account-data declarations; reassess if actual sign-in or account identifiers are implemented.
